proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: $10 free trial credits upon registration. FLUX.1-schnell costs $0.003 per image (approx. 3,300 free images, then extremely cheap PAYG).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides lightning-fast, ultra-reliable API access to FLUX.1-schnell/dev and SDXL. It bypasses GitHub Actions IP bans (unlike AI Horde) and produces superior image quality compared to Pollinations.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Replace Pollinations in the 'produce_coloring_book' and 'produce_kdp_cover' pipelines inside GitHub Actions using a standard OpenAI-compatible Python SDK.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires card verification to unlock the trial credits to prevent bot abuse. Strictly enforce credit limits in code.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 2,500 free search queries upon signup. No credit card required.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Extremely fast and cheap Google Search, Google Images, and Google Shopping scraper API. Essential for programmatic SEO and micro-niche trend validation before production.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Integrate into 'agent_opportunity_hunter' to automate search volume checks and competitor price scraping on Google Shopping.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Rate limits on the free tier can block rapid parallel requests. Must implement a sleep delay in GitHub Actions scripts.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100% free to list and sell 3D printable designs (STL/OBJ). Takes a low platform fee on sales instead of monthly listing fees.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: It is the fastest-growing search engine and marketplace for 3D printing. It has native membership options and less creator saturation than Cults3D for programmatic parametric models.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Add as a secondary distribution target in 'produce_stl_parametric' alongside Cults3D to double the organic reach for 3D printing niches.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires high-quality renders of the STL files to gain organic traction. Code must render the generated STLs automatically.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100% free to publish. They take a 10% cut of the retail price per sale.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Distributes ebooks and low-content paperbacks to Apple Books, Kobo, Barnes & Noble, and Tolino simultaneously. Bypasses KDP's exclusivity rules and reaches non-Amazon global markets automatically.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Integrate as an automated publishing destination for KDP coloring books and low-content planners after initial validation on Amazon KDP.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Stringent formatting guidelines for automated PDF uploads. Layout templates must be mathematically precise.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free to set up. Act as a Merchant of Record. Fees are 5% + $0.50 per transaction.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Handles global sales tax (VAT/TVA in France) automatically. Provides a robust API to generate discount codes, check licenses, and host digital downloads (gamedev assets, PDFs, SVG packs).
proposals.would_integrate_where: Use as the direct-to-consumer checkout backend for Hugo's portfolio, allowing programmatic delivery of 'produce_gamedev_asset_pack' bundles via simple API webhooks.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: High transaction fees on very low-priced items (under $2). Best suited for bundled digital asset packs ($5 to $15).

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 10,000 free characters per month. Access to Text-to-SFX generation API.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Generates cinema-quality, unique sound effects and short audio clips from simple text prompts. Excellent for creating retro/indie gamedev audio asset packs.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Create a new pipeline 'produce_gamedev_sfx_pack' that generates themed audio packs (e.g., UI clicks, retro explosions) to sell on itch.io and Unity Asset Store.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Monthly character limit resets strictly. Audio output must be converted programmatically to standard .wav/.ogg formats before packaging.
